channel.title: Linear incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Linear's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Degraded performance in US region workspaces [resolved]
item.description: Normal levels of operation has been fully restored. Incident is now resolved and closed.

item.title: Increased failures and latency for Android push notifications [resolved]
item.description: Normal functionality has resumed.

item.title: Delayed actions for Linear agent and loops automations [resolved]
item.description: Automated actions, including Loop automations and Linear Agent responses, are now processing normally. We’re taking steps to help prevent this from recurring.

item.title: Documentation site failing to load [resolved]
item.description: Documentation site now loads after refreshing.

item.title: Codex integration sessions failing to start [resolved]
item.description: The connection between Linear and OpenAI was failing and has now been rectified.

item.title: Some customers are seeing issues with Linear loading [resolved]
item.description: Recent feature roll-outs added extra load to our databases, and a fix has been implemented. Thank you for your patience while we worked to resolve this.

item.title: App not loading for some users in India [resolved]
item.description:
An upstream regional networking issue impacted access for some Linear users in India.
The issue has now been resolved, and our service is operating normally for all regions.

item.title: Some customers experiencing issues with Linear loading and syncing [resolved]
item.description: Some customers were experiencing issues with Linear loading and syncing. Performance has returned to normal, and the issue is resolved. We appreciate your patience while we worked on this.

item.title: EU sync delays for some workspaces [resolved]
item.description: Some users with EU-hosted workspaces experienced delays syncing changes for a short period of time this morning. Sync performance has returned to normal, and the issue is resolved. Thank you for your patience while we worked on this.

item.title: Increased latency while using Linear [resolved]
item.description:
The increased latency has been resolved, and Linear should be operating normally again.
We rolled back the query change that caused the slowdown and have confirmed performance has recovered.

item.title: Some users may experience errors loading code diffs [resolved]
item.description:
This issue has been resolved, and the Reviews experience is functioning normally — thank you for your patience.
If you continue to see any trouble, please reach out to support@linear.app and we'll take a look!

item.title: Some customers seeing delays [resolved]
item.description: The delays affecting agent responses and other workflows have been resolved. We're sorry for the disruption.

item.title: Problems with right-clicking or opening context menus on issues [resolved]
item.description: We've identified the problem and deployed a fix. You may need to refresh (⌘+R / CTRL+R) to get the latest changes.

item.title: Partial Linear outage [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved, and Linear is operating normally across all regions. We rolled back the affected services and have confirmed that error rates remain normal. We apologize for the disruption.

item.title: In-App Contact Form experiencing issues [resolved]
item.description:
We've resolved the issue affecting submissions through our in-app contact form, and new support requests are being received successfully again.
Our team will continue reviewing and replying to delayed support requests as quickly as possible.
We apologize for the delay and appreciate your patience.

item.title: Linear Agent code intelligence tools failing to run [resolved]
item.description: Normal functionality has resumed to the Linear Agent's coding intelligence features.

item.title: Delays affecting event processing in our US region [resolved]
item.description: We’ve resolved the delays that were affecting updates for some workspaces hosted in our US region, and service should now be operating normally. We hit an unexpected condition in our event processing that caused the system to back up. If you still see stale information in Linear, please refresh and try again. We are working on a fix to prevent future occurrences, and thank you for your patience while we worked on this.

item.title: Linear not loading for some users [resolved]
item.description:
This incident has now been resolved and Linear should now be loading normally again for all users.
We identified an error with DDOS protection rules being applied in error, and applied mitigation changes to prevent this from affecting user logins.
If you still run into problems accessing Linear after a refresh, please reach out to [support@linear.app](mailto:support@linear.app "support@linear.app").

item.title: Asks Email Intake failing [resolved]
item.description: Asks email intake has been restored and is working again. We identified the issue and implemented a fix, and have confirmed the flow is working again end to end. Please reach out to support@linear.app if you experience any problems with email intake after this time.

item.title: Resolved - Delayed background processing for some users in EU region [resolved]
item.description: Task processing in our EU region was briefly delayed from 12:45 to 13:05 UTC after capacity scaled down too far, which slowed some background actions from completing normally. We scaled capacity back up and processing has recovered. Service should now be operating normally.

item.title: Resolved: Degraded search quality for some US workspaces [resolved]
item.description: Earlier today, some US customers may have seen degraded or incomplete search results for a number of hours. This issue has now been resolved, and search should be working normally again. The impact was caused by backed-up event processing, which has since been cleared. We’re sorry for the disruption and are continuing follow-up work to help prevent similar issues.

item.title: Investigating delays in background processing [resolved]
item.description: We’ve resolved the issue that caused delays in background task processing and search indexing. Systems are now operating normally again. Recent changes should appear as expected in search, and you should no longer experience delays with notifications, webhooks, automations, or other event-driven updates. Please contact [support@linear.app](mailto:support@linear.app) if you continue to see related issues.

item.title: Errors affecting workspaces using cycles [resolved]
item.description:
As noted, an internal migration related to ongoing performance and tech-debt improvements caused errors affecting customers using cycles.
Our team identified and reverted the issue quickly, and service has now fully recovered.
We appreciate your patience as we worked to resolve things!

item.title: Degraded Slack integration performance [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved. Linear Asks, Slack, and Slack agent functionality should now be operating normally after the upstream provider issue was fixed.

item.title: Elevated latency affecting updates in Linear [resolved]
item.description: Performance has returned to normal, and updates in Linear are now processing as expected.

item.title: Linear agent intermittently unresponsive in Slack [resolved]
item.description: We have identified and resolved the issue, this should be working correctly now for all. Thank you for your patience while we worked on this.
